internal_obligations: Connected compact X, n>=2, positive bundle rank and smooth Hermitian metrics stated.
Chern curvature convention uses column frames and first-slot-linear inner products consistently.
Unitarity makes contracted Chern curvature h-Hermitian and scalar curvature forms real.
RC-positivity quantifiers allow a tangent direction depending on each nonzero fiber vector.
Uniform RC-positivity reverses the order of these quantifiers.
Trace of the scalar curvature form equals the fiber pairing with mean curvature.
Nonzero Hermitian form of nonnegative trace has a positive eigenvalue.
Positive scalar evaluation implies nonzero curvature form.
Conformal Gauduchon representative exists by complete existing theorem/proof.
Mean-curvature endomorphism scales by the positive inverse conformal factor.
Closed coordinate ball inside U has compact unit sphere bundle.
Nonnegative smooth bump inside the ball has positive Gauduchon integral.
Rho has zero Gauduchon integral and equals one off the ball.
Existing scalar adjoint theorem yields a real smooth solution for this rho.
Book ddc equals i/(2 pi) partial barpartial, giving P_gamma=2 pi L_gamma.
Chern connection changes by minus t partial f times the identity.
Chern curvature changes by plus t partial barpartial f times the identity.
Fiber pairing acquires the positive exp(-tf) factor and original h-norm.
Off the ball the transformed scalar curvature has positive trace for every nonzero fiber vector.
On the closed ball the largest eigenvalue has a strictly positive uniform minimum delta.
The scalar Hessian has finite global operator bound C, giving delta-tC.
Small positive t works simultaneously on both regions; fiber homogeneity covers all nonzero vectors.
Local metric has exact eigenvalues 1 plus/minus |z| squared over two.
Its first derivatives vanish at zero and all four exact curvature matrices have been reconstructed.
Euclidean mean curvature is zero at the origin.
Taking u=v gives strict positivity; taking v perpendicular to a fixed u gives strict negativity.
The local example asserts only the stated pointwise properties and is not a compact global example.
Uniform fiber positivity implies positive determinant curvature in one direction.
Positive definite mean curvature implies positive trace for the determinant scalar curvature.
A trivial determinant has a global nonvanishing holomorphic frame and curvature minus partial barpartial log norm.
At a global minimum of that log norm every determinant curvature direction is nonpositive.
Conditional distinction requires actual hypotheses; no unchecked global Ricci-flat/K3 existence or Weyl/vanishing chain adopted.
